scenes.headline: How a looped model's first loop guides its last
scenes.sub: Contrastive decoding with the weak model already inside
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Momo! A looped transformer runs one block again and again. Ordinary decoding reads only the last pass.

scenes.text: The first loop is a weaker model that has already been computed, so push the final prediction further away from it.
scenes.say: The first loop is a weaker model, already computed. So push the final prediction further away from it.

steps.say: A looped model feeds the prefix through one shared block, again and again.
After the last loop, the head turns the final state into logits. Ordinary decoding stops here.
But the state after loop one decodes too. Same model, far less compute. A weaker opinion, for free.
Step further from the early logits. Tokens the loops were raising get raised a little more.
